caption: The drawing depicts a square clock face with a decorative black border featuring a repetitive pattern. The background of the clock face is a light beige, simulating a weathered or textured surface. Inside the square, the numbers are represented as black Roman numerals, arranged in a circular manner around the face. At the top center of the clock face, the words "AVE MARIA." are inscribed in blue uppercase letters. Above the inscription, there is a blue and black decorative cross with symmetrical arms, and to the left and right of the cross, there are two eight-pointed stars with circles at their centers, outlined in black. The center of the clock contains a circular element resembling the attachment point for the clock’s hands, with a single long, thin hand extending downward and pointing between V and VI, towards the lower right of the clock face. The entire composition is contained within a black rectangular outline with additional inner details in the corners and around the border.
title: Sun Dial
